evidence.name: Screen field: Which Permission To Ask For
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Which Permission To Ask For" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Which Permission To Ask For
sections.description: Picks which device permission this screen requests: push notifications, ad tracking (needed for accurate ad attribution on iPhones), or location. Only shows when the permission request is turned on. Choose what your funnel truly needs, ad tracking if you rely on ad-network attribution, notifications for re-engaging users later.
